claims: Alaska is known as "The Last Frontier".
Alaska is the largest U.S. state by area.
Alaska is located in the northwest of North America.
Alaska was admitted as the 49th state in 1959.
Juneau is the capital of Alaska.
Anchorage is the largest city in Alaska.
Alaska encompasses over 663,000 square miles.
Alaska has more coastline than all other U.S. states combined.
Denali is located in Alaska.
Denali is the highest mountain in North America.
Denali is 20,310 feet high.
Alaska features tundra in the north and west.
Alaska has temperate rainforests in the southeast.
The currency of Alaska is the United States Dollar (USD).
Denali National Park is home to Denali.
Alaska contains over 100,000 glaciers.
Alaska is home to 229 federally recognized tribes.
Alaska has over 130 volcanoes.
Mike Dunleavy is the governor of Alaska.
Mike Dunleavy is a Republican.
Most of Alaska uses Alaska Time.
The western Aleutian Islands use Hawaii-Aleutian Time
